items.w: ריבה יהוה את יריבי לחם את לחמי
items.title: BATTLE
items.quote: Contend with my adversaries and fight my foes.
items.text: When you are confronted by enemies who seek to harm you, ask Hashem to act for you by defeating them. Even when you need to use the implements of war, it will be Hashem Who is actually wielding them.

items.quote: Hold a shield and armor [to protect me].

items.w: כי חנם טמנו לי שחת רשתם חנם חפרו לנפשי
items.title: WITHOUT CAUSE
items.quote: For without cause they have concealed a pit [to kill] me with their net. Without cause they dug [a pit] to [destroy] my soul..
items.text: I have been the object of unfair and cruel treatment by those who hate me. I look to You to come to my aid and restore my life.

items.w: תבואהו שואה לא ידע ורשתו אשר טמן תלכדו בשואה יפל בה
items.title: CONFIDENCE
items.quote: May a devastating darkness come upon each [of them] without warning. May his net which he concealed ensnare him. May he fall into it in the devastating darkness.
items.text: Restore your confidence in the victory against your enemies by visualizing their defeat.

items.title: REJOICING
items.quote: My soul will feel an intense gladness in Hashem. It will openly rejoice in His yeshuah.
items.text: Openly and joyfully declare your gratitude to Hashem for His yeshuah.

items.w: יהוה מי כמוך מציל עני מחזק ממנו
items.title: INTERVENTION
items.quote: Hashem, who is like You. You save the poor man from [the enemy who is] stronger than he.
items.text: Hashem intervenes in human affairs when necessary to protect the weak.

items.title: LAWS
items.quote: And [You save] the poor and the destitute from one who would rob him.
items.text: The Torah’s laws protect the poor from exploitation.

items.quote: [When they were ill] I went about as for a good friend and as for my own brother.
items.text: Instead of sympathy I was subjected to mockery. My overtures for peace were repaid with hatred.

items.title: MOCKERY
items.quote: But when I limped they were cheerful and gathered [to jeer me].
items.text: Instead of sympathy I was subjected to mockery. My overtures for peace were repaid with hatred.

items.title: ACTION NOW
items.quote: Hashem, how long will You look on?
items.text: Plead with Hashem to take action now.

items.title: RESCUE
items.quote: Rescue my soul from their darkness, my life from the young lions.
items.text: Save me from the cruelty and greed of my enemies.

items.quote: You have seen, Hashem! Don’t be silent. O my L-rd, don’t be distant from me.

items.w: ולשוני תהגה צדקך כל היום תהלתך
items.title: PRAISE
items.quote: Hashem, my tongue will declare Your righteousness all day long with songs of praise.
items.text: Whenever the opportunity presents itself, praise the righteousness of Hashem’s laws and actions.
